html:
Respiratory illness activity remains at seasonal-expected levels across Lawrence and Douglas County as of late February.
Influenza continues to account for the largest share of ED visits this season, with wastewater signal trending slightly upward over the past two weeks.
COVID-19 activity is stable and below last year's levels at this point in the season. RSV activity has passed its seasonal peak and is declining.

Recommendation: Residents who are eligible are encouraged to stay up to date on vaccinations. Testing and vaccination information is available at ldchealth.org.
